subject: music
title: Melody — Shape & Phrasing
welcome_lead: How notes move and group into musical sentences.
meta_desc: KS3 melody: pitch movement, phrases, hooks.
final_note: A melody is a tune with shape and direction.

concepts.def: Tune — a memorable sequence of pitches.
Musical sentence — a small chunk of melody.
Move to the next note in the scale.
Skip over notes to a far one.
Shape of melody as it rises and falls.

walkthroughs.body_html: A step moves to the next note (C to D). A leap jumps over notes (C to G). Most catchy melodies mix steps and leaps to feel both smooth and surprising.
The contour is the shape of a melody — does it rise, fall, arch, or zigzag? Twinkle Twinkle Little Star rises then falls.
A phrase is a musical sentence, usually 4 bars. A hook is a phrase so catchy you can't stop singing it — the chorus of any pop song.
